command:
sudo env CLIENT_IP="$NODE_IP" sh <<'RADIUS_PREP'
set -eu
handover=/srv/legacy2/radius-network-authentication/access.txt
user=$(awk '/^Demonstration user:/ {sub(/^[^:]*:[[:space:]]*/, ""); print; exit}' "$handover")
pass=$(awk '/^Demonstration password:[REDACTED] {sub(/^[^:]*:[[:space:]]*/, ""); print; exit}' "$handover")
[ -n "$user" ] && [ -n "$pass" ]
escape_value() { printf '%s' "$1" | sed 's/\\/\\\\/g; s/"/\\"/g'; }
user_esc=$(escape_value "$user")
pass_esc=$(escape_value "$pass")
secret=[REDACTED] rand -hex 32)
umask 077
printf 'client legacy-node2 {\n    ipaddr = %s\n    secret = [REDACTED]}\n' "$CLIENT_IP" "$secret" > /tmp/legacy-node2-client.conf
printf '%s Cleartext-Password :[REDACTED] "%s"\n' "$user_esc" "$pass_esc" > /tmp/legacy-demo-user.conf
install -d -m 700 /etc/radiusclient
printf '%s\n' "$secret" > /etc/radiusclient/legacy-node1.secret
chmod 600 /etc/radiusclient/legacy-node1.secret
chown antrieb:antrieb /tmp/legacy-node2-client.conf /tmp/legacy-demo-user.conf
printf 'prepared client=%s user-records=%s secret-bytes=[REDACTED] "$CLIENT_IP" "$(wc -l < /tmp/legacy-demo-user.conf)" "$(wc -c < /etc/radiusclient/legacy-node1.secret)"

set -u
handover=/srv/legacy2/radius-network-authentication/access.txt
user=$(awk '/^Demonstration user:/ {sub(/^[^:]*:[[:space:]]*/, ""); print; exit}' "$handover")
pass=$(awk '/^Demonstration password:[REDACTED] {sub(/^[^:]*:[[:space:]]*/, ""); print; exit}' "$handover")

[ -n "$user" ] && [ -n "$pass" ] && [ -n "$secret" ] && [ -n "$server" ]
correct_out=$(timeout 8 radtest "$user" "$pass" "$server" 0 "$secret" 2>&1 || true)
wrong_out=$(timeout 8 radtest "$user" "${pass}__incorrect" "$server" 0 "$secret" 2>&1 || true)
wrong_secret=[REDACTED] rand -hex 32)
secret_out=[REDACTED] 8 radtest "$user" "$pass" "$server" 0 "$wrong_secret" 2>&1 || true)
case "$correct_out" in *Access-Accept*) correct=PASS;; *) correct=FAIL;; esac
case "$wrong_out" in *Access-Reject*) wrong_password=[REDACTED];; *) wrong_password=[REDACTED];; esac
case "$secret_out" in *Access-Accept*) wrong_secret_result=[REDACTED];; *) wrong_secret_result=[REDACTED];; esac
case "$secret_out" in *Access-Reject*) wrong_secret_observation=[REDACTED];; *'no response'*) wrong_secret_observation=[REDACTED];; *) wrong_secret_observation=[REDACTED];; esac
printf 'correct_credentials_access_accept=%s\n' "$correct"
printf 'wrong_credentials_access_reject=%s\n' "$wrong_password"
printf 'wrong_client_secret_not_accepted=[REDACTED] observation=%s\n' "$wrong_secret_result" "$wrong_secret_observation"
[ "$correct" = PASS ] && [ "$wrong_password" = PASS ] && [ "$wrong_secret_result" = PASS ]
RADIUS_TESTS
